## What changed

<!-- One or two sentences a non-coder would understand. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new behaviour
- [ ] `fix` — a bug fix
- [ ] `refactor` — same behaviour, different structure
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `test` — tests only
- [ ] `chore` — tooling, dependencies, config

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] `ruff check` and `ruff format --check` pass
- [ ] No API key, transcript, or recording in the diff
- [ ] Microphone stream, keyboard listener, and clipboard restored on the error path too
- [ ] No new hardcoded timings or device names — they belong in `config.json`
- [ ] Functions under 50 lines, files under 400
- [ ] Manual check done and screenshot attached, if the change is visible to the user
